title: Balaclava Gang: Action
heading: The Bank Robbery music video: the balaclava gang
moodboard_intro: ROUND 3c, GESTURES: twelve sarcastic stage-rapper moves (g01 to g12), two takes each, from three sealed writers using only web research. Each is caught at the peak of the move on its line: the chop in the vault, the empty-drawer shrug, counting off in the idle factory, the mock bow in the boardroom, and so on. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note on any. Faults I saw: g09 shows a readable GIN crate; g03's triangle sits near the centre of the mask; g04's masks are small in frame.

beats.name: Intro
beats.blurb: The gang walks in; the doors burst; the getaway skids.

beats.name: Verse 1
beats.blurb: Money from a tree, make hay, where does it go, grandma freezing, stimulus checks.

beats.name: Verse 2
beats.blurb: Rent seeking, the meeting, the Fed, the printer, fiat debt.

beats.name: Chorus
beats.blurb: Robbery! Call the police! Debasement in the basement, the printer burning.

beats.name: Verse 3
beats.blurb: Elastic cash, the flash, the angry mob, blame, dilution, distraction, the hand.

beats.name: Verse 4
beats.blurb: The devil's radio station, vaults like a wheelbarrow, the narrow ledge, your own supply.

beats.name: Verse 5
beats.blurb: The scam, bail out, winter, inflation, print more, revolution, give, cake.

beats.name: Action
beats.blurb: Hot rods, Tommy guns, chases, rum-runners, raids: Jack's 'more cool action'.

beats.name: Sarcastic stage-rap gestures
